comparison.objective: Return a tilted window sash to its frame and latch it, not recover finishing media.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load support with simultaneous latch retraction versus sifting and bridge clearing.
comparison.success_condition: Sash upright on pivots with both latches engaged; no mass recovery or spill criterion.
comparison.reason: Although both use two arms and load sharing, the tested latch-under-load ability is different. Rubric is complete.
